name: calendar-notes
description: Mirror CalDAV events and CardDAV contacts as notes; the server stays the source of truth.

scripts.typecheck:scripts: if test -d ../tools/obsidian-cdp; then tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit; else echo 'typecheck:scripts uebersprungen: ../tools/obsidian-cdp fehlt (die Treiber importieren die zentrale CDP-Bruecke aus dem Dach-Checkout; in CI/fremden Checkouts nicht vorhanden)'; fi
scripts.gate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:test && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm test && npm run check:pure && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "${OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN_DIR:?set OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN_DIR}"/

author: Johannes Kaindl
